# NXDOM — Nusantara eXtreme Development Object Model

> Organisasi open source dari Indonesia yang membangun teknologi fundamental:
> dari AI coding agent, desktop SDK, IDE, database, hingga infrastruktur web —
> semuanya jalan di hardware biasa, tanpa vendor lock-in.

Part of: **NXDOM ecosystem** · Company: [PT Tatiye Digital Solusindo](https://iyanrsaleh.github.io/tatiye/) · Kegiatan: [Facebook — Tatiye.net](https://www.facebook.com/TatiyedotNet)

---

## Flagship Projects

| Proyek | Apa | Rilis | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| **[NxCode IDE](https://github.com/nxcodeobject/nxcode-ide)** | Editor kode desktop native (C++/Qt 6): explorer, source control, API client, database, terminal agen AI, syntax highlighting 400+ bahasa | [9 rilis](https://github.com/nxcodeobject/nxcode-ide/releases) | Windows · Linux |
| **[Nxzilla](https://github.com/iyanrsaleh/nxzilla)** | Jembatan terminal ke server remote: SSH/SFTP & FTP/FTPS, push/pull, deteksi konflik, multi-environment, OS keyring | [9 rilis](https://github.com/iyanrsaleh/nxzilla/releases) | Windows · Linux |
| **[NxDom PHP](https://github.com/iyanrsaleh/nxdom-php)** | *Write JavaScript. Run on PHP.* Backend runtime sebagai PHP native extension C — satu install per server, semua app langsung punya router/database/auth | [3 rilis](https://github.com/iyanrsaleh/nxdom-php/releases) | PHP 8.1 ZTS · PHP 8.3 |
| **[NxfireDB](https://github.com/iyanrsaleh/nxfiredb)** | Lapisan lokal di depan Firebase RTDB: JSON ke localhost, cache <1ms, antrian offline, realtime WebSocket, SDK 5 bahasa | [4 rilis](https://github.com/iyanrsaleh/nxfiredb/releases) | Windows · Linux |
| **[NxPort](https://github.com/iyanrsaleh/nxport)** | Monitor port interaktif real-time: TCP/UDP + proses pemilik + direktori kerjanya (PEB/proc) — kill, health check, API internal | [1 rilis](https://github.com/iyanrsaleh/nxport/releases) | Windows · Linux |
| **[nxcloud](https://github.com/iyanrsaleh/nxcloud)** | Manajer Cloudflare Tunnel zero-dependency: satu perintah = ingress + DNS CNAME otomatis; fallback saat login cloudflared rusak | CLI · Windows · Linux |
| **[NxCode (nxc)](https://github.com/nxcodeobject/code)** | AI coding agent di terminal: Build & Plan agents, multi-provider models, MCP, LSP | CLI | Open source (MIT) |
| **[NxNode](https://github.com/nxdevmodel/nxnode)** | Node.js package manager dengan shared store — satu salinan package dipakai lintas semua project | CLI | MIT |
| **[NxSocket](https://github.com/nxcodeobject/nxsocket-src)** | Platform realtime self-hostable: WebSocket gateway ber-token, presence, chat, WebRTC signalling | Windows · Linux |
| **[TeritipDB](https://github.com/teritipdb/teritipdb)** | Database dokumen berbasis JSON — cepat, ringan | MIT |

**Total: 25+ rilis publik** · Windows + Linux · C, C++, PHP-C extension, Node/JS, Qt · CI rilis otomatis

## Principles

1. **Zero-dependency berarti zero-dependency** — binary tunggal, tanpa runtime tambahan
2. **Jalan di hardware/infrastruktur yang sudah dimiliki** — tanpa VPS khusus, tanpa cloud wajib
3. **Local-first & self-hosted** — data tetap milik pengguna
4. **Open standards** — HTTP, SSH, WebSocket, JSON Schema
5. **MIT license** di semua proyek open source
